description.zh:
配置了DPI功能的实例类型：

- **acl**：表示访问控制实例。
- **qos**：表示QoS策略实例。
description.en:
The type of instance for which the DPI feature is configured:

- **acl**: a Resource Access Management instance.
- **qos**: a QoS policy instance.

description.zh:
分页查询时允许每页展示的配置异常的最大条目数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**。

默认值：**10**。
description.en:
The maximum number of configuration errors to return on each page.

Valid values: **1** to **100**.

Default value: **10**.
The token for the next page of results.

description.zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。
您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway instance is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the regions and their IDs that Smart Access Gateway supports.
The ID of the instance for which the DPI feature is configured.
The ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

title.zh: 查询应用识别DPI配置异常信息

descriptions.zh: 如果您配置了基于应用的访问控制实例或QoS策略实例，并将其关联到了智能接入网关实例上，您可以通过调用本接口查看您创建的访问控制规则或QoS策略五元组规则是否都已经成功应用到了目标智能接入网关实例上。如果有未应用成功的配置，本接口会将配置异常信息返回给您。
descriptions.en: If you configure an application-based Resource Access Management instance or a Quality of Service (QoS) policy instance and associate it with a Smart Access Gateway instance, you can call this operation to check whether the access control rules or QoS quintuple rules are successfully applied to the target Smart Access Gateway instance. If a configuration fails to apply, this operation returns information about the error.
